name: comp-544
title: Image Cover Dropzone
description: A dashed rounded panel inviting you to drop an image or click to browse, with a 5MB note underneath. Once a file loads, the panel becomes the picture itself, with a round close button in the corner.
use: One image must be chosen and previewed in place, such as a cover or avatar.
avoid: It accepts a single image capped at 5MB and offers no crop, resize or multiple-file support.
a11y: The hidden file input is labelled and shows a focus ring, but the clickable wrapper is kept out of the tab order. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded rectangle outlined by a fine dashed border on black. In the middle a small circle holds a photo-with-up-arrow glyph, followed by a bold white instruction and a dimmer size note. Loaded, it becomes a blue gradient image with a dark round X at the top right.
behaves: Dragging a file over the box lightens its fill; dropping or browsing swaps the whole area for the chosen picture and reveals the remove button. Files over 5MB instead raise a red error line.
customise: The 5MB ceiling, the image-only filter and all the copy are written in the file; colours and the dashed border follow theme tokens.
weight: light: A hidden file input and one preview image; no animation loop.
